gates: grounded (contact) and floating on every grounded character: 5 of 6 bad frames caught, 0 of 3 good rejected
floatingShadow only in shots where no character stands on a surface (it read good-21's wet reflection as a blob)
onModel with the flat-drawing-vs-3D wording: 9 of 9 right
dropped: shadowDirection: NO on all nine — shadows are cast from the treatment's key by construction (stage.cast_shadow) and reviewed by a person
pasted: YES on every good keyframe — the fix is in the pipeline (the bird re-rendered in the plate's light) and onModel keeps the design
recorded, not gating: contactRatio: a soft second opinion (good-08's owl reads 0.99)
chromaShift and lumaRatio: they did not separate the two sets
decision.missed: bad-o37.5 (the crane and the beaver pasted at the bar) passes both questions: a person's review remains required (gate.json reviewedBy).

onModel._: Nine pairs: five v3 keyframe characters against their own render, four against another bird's render (the crop found by the vision model).
